name: localvoxtral-mod
description: Shows whether localvoxtral is connected to this Claude Code session, puts dictated text in the prompt box, shows the dictation above the prompt, and ends a turn on your spoken stop phrase. A Claude Code mod: needs a Claude Code build that loads hooks modules, and does nothing on one that does not.

publisher_path.title: Publisher path
publisher_path.description: Absolute path to the localvoxtral-claude-hook publisher. Set automatically when localvoxtral installs the plugin; only needed by hand if the app lives somewhere unusual.
